data.long_meaning: Goharjahan is a Persian name that means 'Bountiful, Generous'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, reflecting the blessings of Allah. The name Goharjahan carries the meaning “Bountiful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Goharjahan usually hope their child will grow to embody bountiful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Goharjahan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bountiful, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Goharjahan total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
